evidence: Homepage lists 8 job postings with title, company, location, salary, date, tags, industry/type badges.
Each job card shows title, company, location, salary range, date posted, industry, job type, and skills.
Selecting Industry=Technology filtered from 8 to 2 jobs matching Technology industry. Location and Job Type comboboxes also present.
Searching "React" narrowed results from 8 to 1 job (Senior Frontend Developer) matching skill keyword.
Both filter selection and keyword search updated the job list and "Showing N jobs" count immediately without page reload.
Job detail page for job-1 shows full description, responsibilities, requirements, and Required Skills section with tags.
Application form (Full Name, Email, Phone, Cover Letter/Message) submitted successfully with a confirmation toast "Application submitted!".
Submission returned success toast confirming receipt, no errors.
Submitting the form empty was blocked (form remained, no success toast); submitting with an invalid email format ("not-an-email") was also blocked.

actual: Submitted a second application to job-1 using the identical name/email (test.user@example.com) already used moments before; the system accepted it and showed "Application submitted!" again instead of rejecting/blocking the duplicate.

evidence: Filled Post a Job form (title, industry, employment type, location, salary range, description, skill) and submitted; toast "Job posted successfully!" appeared and new listing "QA Automation Engineer" appeared on employer dashboard and was live.

issue: No edit functionality for job listings
actual: Each job listing row on the employer dashboard only exposes an applications-count button and a delete icon (confirmed via delete confirmation dialog "Delete this job?"). No edit/update link, button, or page was found anywhere (checked DOM for any element containing "edit", and clicking the job title did not navigate to an edit form). Delete itself worked correctly (job removed, Active Jobs count decremented from 6 to 5), but employers cannot edit an existing published job.

evidence: Employer Dashboard "Your Job Listings" section lists all jobs posted by the employer (Sarah Chen/TechCorp) with title, tags, location, salary and post date.
Clicking the applications-count button ("4") on "Senior Frontend Developer" expanded an "Applications (4)" panel listing each applicant's name, email, phone (if given), date, and message.
Submitting the Post a Job form empty was blocked; all required fields (title, min/max salary, description) showed native "Please fill out this field." validation messages, and no job was created.

Applications panel for a job clearly separates each applicant into its own card with distinct name heading, email, phone, submission date, and message (e.g. Test User, Alex Johnson, Maria Garcia shown as separate distinguishable entries).

issue: No access control preventing job seekers from posting jobs
actual: The app has no login/authentication/role system (no login or sign-up links found in the DOM). The "Post a Job" link and /employer/post-job page are freely accessible to any visitor without any identity check, so any job seeker can post a job opening exactly as an employer would.
